title: opencode-openai-compact configuration
description: Configuration schema for the opencode-openai-compact OpenCode plugin.

$schema.description: JSON schema URL for editor integration.

enabled.description: Enables or disables OpenAI Responses API compaction checkpoint injection.
Enables or disables compaction wrapping for this OpenCode provider.

compactModel.description: Model sent to the OpenAI Responses API compaction v2 request for this provider. Null follows the model used by the latest conversation part.

compactReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort sent to the compaction v2 request. Null follows the effort selected for the current conversation.

providers.description: OpenCode provider ids to wrap, keyed by provider id.

compact.description: Internal request header used to mark compaction calls. Names are trimmed and normalized to lowercase at runtime.

session.description: Internal request header used to pass the OpenCode session id into fetch. It must differ from compact and cannot use reserved protocol or authentication names.

endpointPath.description: Responses API endpoint path suffix to intercept. Whitespace-only and root paths are rejected.

compactEndpointPath.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Compaction v2 always uses endpointPath.

compactBodyKeys.description: Request body keys copied from the original responses request into the compaction v2 request.

summary.default:
Context compacted.
Following conversations will continue from this compacted checkpoint.
summary.description: Synthetic assistant text shown after a successful compact call.

retentionDays.description: Global retention policy for the shared checkpoint database. Only the fixed global OpenCode config directory may set this value; non-global overrides are ignored with a warning.

deleteOnSessionDeleted.description: Deletes stored rows when OpenCode emits session.deleted. When false, rows remain for retention purposes but are tombstoned and never used again.
